description: Search the FULL TEXT of the Washington Administrative Code (WAC) by topic or keyword — "workplace safety bulletin board", "security deposit", "septic system permit", "cannabis retailer". Calls the Washington State Legislature's own full-text search index of every WAC section (it matches rule TEXT, not just captions), returns matching citations with captions, highlighted snippets and the index-wide match count. Optionally restrict to a title or chapter with cite_prefix ("296" for L&I, "458-20" for Revenue excise-tax rules). Call wa_wac_section with a citation for the full text and history. Keyless.

cite_prefix.description: Optional WAC title or chapter to restrict results to, e.g. "296" or "296-800".

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "safety bulletin board" or "landlord deposit". Plain words; the index is Elasticsearch-style (all terms, stemmed).

name: wa_wac_search
title: Wa Wac Search
